Evan and Sam are supportive friends who encourage each other through health and life challenges. Their location is unspecified. Dates below are 2023–24 unless noted.

**Evan:** Enjoys watercolor painting, hiking, skiing, snowboarding, skating, kayaking, driving, and time in nature. A friend introduced him to watercolor a few years before May 2023; he says it relieves stress, helps him find peace, and expresses feelings without words. He began painting classes around August 2023 to improve and meet people; he likes landscapes and capturing nature’s atmosphere. His paintings have included mountains and a horse, a sunset inspired by an old vacation, a cactus inspired by a September 2023 road trip, an introspective figurative work exhibited with a friend’s help, and joyful bird art. He also paints according to his mood. In spring 2023 a pink-flowering tree cheered him up; its photo brightened Sam’s day in January 2024.

Evan drove his family’s new Prius on trips; his old Prius broke down, was repaired, and sold. In the week before 18 May 2023, he and family hiked in the Rockies. On 20–21 May they visited Jasper, drove the Icefields Parkway, and enjoyed glaciers, lakes, and a cabin among mountains and forest. On 24 May he shared a photo described as a person holding a book by a lake while saying he had photographed a glacier. In July 2023 he drove to Banff and skied; he loved the views and hoped to return. He also took a July road trip to the Rockies. In summer 2023 he kayaked on a lake at sunset and found the water peaceful. In the week of 31 July–6 August he visited Canada and met a woman who made him feel alive; they had fun together. By 13 August he called her his new significant other. On 26 December he said he had married a Canadian woman during the prior week; he believes in love at first sight and described a spark, happiness, and fulfillment. He and his partner told extended family on 5 January 2024; family were happy and supportive. They planned a February 2024 Canadian honeymoon with skiing, local food, snowy scenery, and poutine. On 6–7 January they tried snowshoeing, which he enjoyed.

Evan has children; family is his “rock,” and he loves making memories with them. On 7 August he shared a photo of his children on a swing set. A family motto from Banff is “Bring it on Home.” His family planned a reunion for summer 2024. His son hurt an ankle playing soccer on 12 August; it was not serious but sore on 15 August. His son fell off a bike on 12 December and was doing better by 17 December, pictured with crutches and backpack.

Evan has worked on his health for about two years, motivated by family. A palpitation in the week of 29 May 2023 frightened him. He reduced processed food and sugar (especially ginger snaps, his weakness), ate more fruit and vegetables, walked, and exercised; he said these changes helped. He had a gym membership, used a fitness watch, and began weightlifting around October 2022. He twisted his knee on 25 August; it limited activity. He swam and considered PT; after another basketball-related knee injury before 6 October, PT helped somewhat and he did easy exercises. By 16 October he was back at the gym and gaining strength. He likes morning walks and says fitness improves wellbeing. His healthy snack recipe: energy balls with coconut and oats.

Evan lost his job in October 2023 in company layoffs and was job-hunting by 9 November. His peaceful beach spot near home helps him unwind; he and Sam planned a December visit. A small island where he grew up is his serene “happy place.” He loses his keys weekly; Sam suggested a GPS tracker. He received a 1968 Kustom K-200A guitar from a close friend. On 9 January 2024 he drank too much with friends and accidentally urinated near someone’s roses; he apologized, felt embarrassed, and promised to be careful. His partner understood but was displeased.

**Sam:** At 10, had a memorable, fun, long hike with Sam’s father. In May 2023 had no settled hobby and was considering painting; on 24 May said they would try it without stressing. Sam later learned drawing, journaled and wrote creatively to process feelings, and occasionally sketched. Sam was inspired by a painting of a woman holding flowers at an exhibit in December 2023.

Sam has repeatedly pursued healthier habits and struggled with weight, cravings, motivation, and family pressure. A check-up shortly before 24 May 2023 upset Sam about weight; friends mocked Sam’s weight on 21 July. Sam planned gym exercise for 28 July and started a diet/exercise routine on 21 August, initially feeling great. On 2 October a doctor called Sam’s weight a serious health risk. Sam became a Weight Watchers group coach by 9 November and felt proud. Sam had gastritis after an ER visit for severe stomach pain on 14–15 October. In November, discomfort limited movement and goals were hard. Sam has tried meal planning, cooking classes, healthier recipes (including grilled salmon with vegetables and chicken-vegetable stir-fry), reducing soda/candy, and flavored seltzer; cravings often stem from stress, boredom, or seeking comfort. Sam likes morning runs, though health issues and extra weight have felt limiting. On 10 January 2024 Sam made a meal/workout schedule, planned a doctor visit to discuss diet and low-impact exercise, and hoped diet/yoga would help. Sam had not yet found enjoyable low-impact exercise; car rides and nature helped relax. Sam planned beach walks.

Sam and Evan discussed painting together for 16 September 2023; Evan recommended acrylics, brushes, canvas/paper, and palette. They discussed hikes and a lake with nearby trails, two hours’ drive away (unnamed); Sam planned to visit. Sam took friends hiking on 29 December. They also discussed kayaking; Sam and a mate traveled through Lake Tahoe and tried kayaking near a lake around 14 October. Sam shared a photo of kayaks on a riverbank. In August Sam said a motivational quote was “Don’t fear it, just take the first step,” and valued celebrating small wins. Sam’s recurring dream is flying over skyscrapers; Evan suggested dream interpretation and later lucid-dream practice. Sam watched *The Godfather* on 9 January 2024 and quoted “I’m gonna make him an offer he can’t refuse.” Sam’s family is a rock; they had homemade lasagna on 6 January. A pie photo was from a cousin’s wedding, not Sam’s baking.

**Other shared details:** Evan advised small, sustainable health changes, enjoyable exercise, goals, and workout buddies; offered to exercise with Sam and weightlifting guidance (form, trainer, start light, progress gradually, consistency). Sam appreciates his support. Evan suggested seltzer, fruit/popcorn, yoga, swimming, walking, and beach outings. Sam attended a Weight Watchers meeting on 4 December and shared a fruit-and-yogurt smoothie bowl. Sam’s phone navigation malfunctioned in October; later phone problems caused stress. Sam often found supermarket self-checkout broken. In December Evan’s new Prius broke down; he found it frustrating but considered other ways to travel and stay active. A minor mountain-road accident on 23–24 December involved Evan and others; everyone was okay. Sam had a countryside photo (field, fence, dirt road) taken 4–10 January 2024.
